newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean soldier shot dead in friendly fire. [CORRECTED 03:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: S.Korean soldier shot dead in friendly fire. [CORRECTED 03:00 GMT]

text.p: A South Korean corporal shot dead an officer (corrects to make clear it was a corporal who shot the officer) after mistaking him for a North Korean infiltrator in a massive manhunt for fugitive northern agents on the east coast, a Defence Ministry spokesman said on Friday.
A South Korean captain was shot in the head on Thursday night after the colonel heard a sound in the woods and thought it was a North Korean infiltrator, the spokesman said.
"Both soldiers were hunting for the fugitive North Korean infiltrators when the accident occurred," the spokesman said.
"The soldier thought the other soldier was a North Korean infiltrator when he heard sounds in the woods."

Thousands of South Korean troops are searching the east coast area for Northern agents put ashore by a grounded submarine last month. South Korean soldiers have already killed 22 of the 26 north Korean infiltrators and captured one alive.
The Defence Ministry has said it believed the remaining northern agents were responsible for the deaths of three South Korean villagers in the eastern Mount Odae area earlier this week.
